prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1169; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas, trying to make a left turn onto the main road.
Q: What was the traffic signal showing for you at the time?
A: My light was green, but I had a yield arrow for oncoming traffic. I waited for a gap and started turning.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming straight through the intersection hit the rear passenger side of my car. I didn't see it until the impact.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbags did not deploy, but I was jolted forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck and back strain.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn my head to check mirrors. My lower back aches after I sit for more than twenty minutes.
Q: Have you missed any work because of these injuries?
A: I've taken some time off and I'm limited to lighter duties right now. I'm still working through the details with my doctor.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following my treatment plan and I want this resolved fairly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
